attractions.name: Chor Minor Madrasa
attractions.description: Early 19th-century madrasa whose name means 'Four Minarets', famous for four uniquely decorated turquoise domes.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Bolo Hauz Mosque
attractions.description: Mosque dating to 1712 opposite the Ark Fortress, known for wooden columns reflected in the pool in front; once used by the Emir for Friday prayers.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Ark Fortress of Bukhara
attractions.description: One of the oldest structures in Bukhara, the royal residence of the Emirs for centuries and a city within a city with courts, offices, libraries and living quarters; parts damaged in 1920.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Kalan Mosque (Kalyan Mosque)
attractions.description: One of the largest mosques in Central Asia, holding over 10,000 worshippers, with a grand courtyard and arched galleries from the 16th century.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Kalyan Minaret
attractions.description: 46 m tall minaret dating from the 12th century, once a call-to-prayer tower and caravan landmark; legend says Genghis Khan spared it.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Labi Hovuz (Lyabi-Hauz)
attractions.description: 17th-century square built around a pool, surrounded by madrasas, teahouses and restaurants; especially charming at sunset.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx
